transformations.rationale: Adapted the inherent `&mut self` receiver to the explicit harness receiver `slice: &mut [T]`; no target semantics were changed.

Represented the Rust 1.96 unsafe expression `&mut *index.get_unchecked_mut(self)` with one target-local boundary named `rust_1_96_sliceindex_get_unchecked_mut_ref`, covering the SliceIndex raw mutable pointer result and dereference guaranteed by the frozen trait safety contract.
